evidence.observation: O2 6.5 ppm at growth onset, consistent with prior purge/ramp baseline ~5 ppm
O2 rises monotonically through growth (6.5→12.3→16.2→19.5→25.7 ppm) with no corresponding change in Ar flow
Ar steady at ~100 sccm, so the O2 rise is not a dilution/flow artifact
T holds 750 °C at setpoint with stable heater power ~46%, control loop nominal
Not installed; telemetry null, so tube atmosphere/leak-tightness cannot be independently verified

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure (gauge not installed) to distinguish a genuine air in-leak from O2-sensor drift; a flow-step or Ar-shutoff response test on the O2 signal, or continued O2 trending, would discriminate.
